blocks.text: This Carpool Agreement ("Agreement") is made as of {{carpool_date}} between:
Group may be referred to as the "Carpool Group."

{{commute_schedule}} (e.g., Monday–Friday, departure at 7:30 AM, return at 5:30 PM)

blocks.text: The cost sharing arrangement for this carpool is:

rows: {{cost_model}} (Equal split per ride / Equal split per month / Per-mile allocation / Other)
{{costs_shared}} (gas, tolls, parking, maintenance contribution, insurance contribution, other)
If Driver uses the Vehicle for non-carpool purposes (personal trips, weekends), those costs are NOT shared.
If a Rider is absent on a given day, the Rider still pays their share if the Driver departs as scheduled (no "ghost ride" refund unless agreed).

items: Provide a safe, reliable, and fuel-efficient Vehicle in good working condition.
Maintain valid driver's license, vehicle registration, and auto insurance.
Comply with all traffic laws and regulations.
Arrive at pickup locations at the scheduled time. Wait {{wait_time_carpool}} minutes for late Riders.
Not engage in distracted driving, aggressive driving, or driving under the influence.
Maintain a smoke-free, pet-free (unless agreed), and clean Vehicle.
Communicate any schedule changes, vehicle issues, or route changes to the Carpool Group in advance.
Not make unauthorized stops or detours.
{{driver_carpool_reps}}
Be ready at the pickup location at the scheduled time. The Driver will wait {{wait_time_carpool}} minutes.
Notify the Driver/Group in advance if unable to ride on a given day (by {{absence_notice_time}}).
Pay their share of costs as agreed.
Treat the Driver and Vehicle with respect.
Not engage in disruptive, unsafe, or illegal behavior during rides.
Not damage or vandalize the Vehicle.
Not exceed the maximum passenger capacity of the Vehicle.
Share the vehicle appropriately (backseat preferred for non-driver adults, seatbelt use required).
Not bring unauthorized additional passengers without group consent.
{{rider_carpool_reps}}
The Carpool Group agrees to a regular schedule as described in Section 1.
Schedule changes (holidays, sick days, working from home, early departures) should be communicated as early as possible.
The Driver may occasionally need to adjust the schedule or route due to traffic, vehicle issues, or personal circumstances. The Driver will notify Riders in advance when possible.
Riders may occasionally need to be picked up or dropped off at alternate locations. This should be arranged in advance and may affect schedule and costs.
No Rider is guaranteed a ride. The Driver retains discretion over which Riders to transport, subject to the principles of this Agreement.
{{absence_policy_1}}
{{absence_policy_2}}
{{absence_policy_3}}
If a Rider is absent, the Rider's share of costs for that day may be redistributed among present Riders or waived, depending on the cost sharing model.
If the Driver is absent, the Driver is not obligated to provide a substitute driver. Riders are responsible for their own transportation on Driver-absent days.
Driver is responsible for routine vehicle maintenance (oil changes, tire rotation, etc.) at Driver's expense.
Riders contribute to fuel and wear-and-tear costs as agreed in Section 3.
Riders should not eat messy foods, drink open containers, or create excessive mess in the Vehicle.
Riders must clean up after themselves (trash, spills, etc.).
If a Rider causes significant damage to the Vehicle beyond normal wear and tear, the Rider is responsible for repair costs.
{{maintenance_cleanliness_extra}}

blocks.text: This is a private cost-sharing arrangement among individuals. It is NOT a commercial transportation service. The Driver is not a common carrier, taxi service, or ride-sharing platform driver.

items: Each Participant assumes the risks inherent in riding in a motor vehicle.
The Driver is not liable for injuries or damages arising from the carriage, except to the extent caused by the Driver's gross negligence or willful misconduct.
Each Participant is encouraged to maintain their own personal auto injury insurance.
If a Participant is injured, their own insurance (health, auto, disability) is the primary source of coverage.
{{liability_carpool_extra}}
This Agreement continues until terminated by any Party with {{termination_notice_carpool}} days written notice to the Carpool Group.
The Agreement also terminates if the Driver sells or replaces the Vehicle, moves out of the carpool corridor, or is unable to drive.
Upon termination, no Party owes any continuing obligation to the others, except for unpaid cost shares incurred before termination.
The Parties may agree to a new carpool arrangement on different terms at any time.

blocks.text: The Parties agree to resolve any disputes through good-faith discussion first. If discussion fails, the Parties agree to {{dispute_resolution_carpool}}.
This Agreement is governed by the laws of {{governing_state}}.
By signing below, each Party acknowledges having read, understood, and agreed to this Carpool Agreement.
